title: Launch photos: Add a photo and Skip for now on the to-do, remembered across reloads

source.ref: Vera launch fan-out lane B. Daniel's ruling 2026-10-28: photos encouraged, plain Skip, change any time, a skipped photo stays on the to-do.

detail: The Space cover and logo to-do items now carry Add a photo (an upload tray that reuses uploadSpaceImage and setSpaceImages, so it writes the same spaces.cover_image_url / brand_logo_url the item reads) and Skip for now. A skip is kept in the space_launch steps jsonb under photoSkips (lib/launch/state.ts pure functions, lib/launch/store.ts write), so no migration. It flows into InventoryItem.skipped; a skipped photo stays on the list with quiet copy and an easy Add one. No Spotlight photo item: the launch Spotlight layout has no image slot to read honestly.
